thread:
sophia.k: Quick heads-up — planned runtime pinning tomorrow 02:00 UTC (eu-west + us-central). Target is a minor pin to v2.3.1 for latency regressions observed on long-context jobs. ETA 75–90m, we'll stagger regions. Draft statuspage + customer email below. Need eng-oncall + product signoff before we publish.

deploy-bot: Deploy window created: 2024-11-01 02:00 UTC -> 2024-11-01 03:30 UTC. Action: runtime.pin v2.3.1 -> all-hosted (stagger eu-west then us-central). Canary cluster scheduled at 01:30 UTC.

tyler.r: ETA looks fine. Are we expecting any auto-rollbacks? if canary fails, do we automatic rollback to v2.3.0 or hold?

maria.s: Preference is: canary fail -> hold rollout (no auto-rollback) so we can inspect traces. We can trigger rollback manually to v2.3.0 within 10m. I'll add a canary-health check to the pipeline: errors > 2% AND 95th latency +50ms -> hold.

sophia.k: noted. I'll add that to the statuspage text. Also attaching comms snippets. Please comment edits inline.

sophia.k: STATUSPAGE SNIPPET (short):
```
Scheduled maintenance: runtime pinning (minor patch)
Start: 2024-11-01 02:00 UTC
Expected duration: ~90 minutes (staggered across regions)
Impact: brief increases in tail latency for a subset of long-context requests; most customers unaffected. We will monitor and rollback if critical regressions occur.
Updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/----
```

liaison.cust: Could we add a line for Dedicated customers re: no automatic change to pinned versions unless opted-in? Some enterprise teams need explicit consent.

sophia.k: Good point — will add dedicated/customer opt-in note in the email.

sophia.k: CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT (short):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — runtime pinning (Nov 1)
Hi {{first_name}},
We're planning a brief maintenance window to pin the runtime used by hosted inference clusters (eu-west and us-central) to v2.3.1. This is a minor patch to address recent latency variance on long-context workloads. We expect up to 90 minutes of staggered activity beginning at 02:00 UTC. Most customers will see no disruption; some long-context requests may see short-lived increased latency. Dedicated and Private deployments are not changed by this maintenance.
If you have pinned model versions or specific SLA constraints, reply and we'll coordinate a custom window.
Thanks — Redwood Support
```

tyler.r: small edit suggestion: replace "pin the runtime used by hosted inference clusters" -> "apply a pin to hosted runtime images" to avoid ambiguity. Also add a line about rollback policy.

sophia.k: applied in next draft. Rollback note: "If we observe critical regressions during canary, we'll hold the rollout and, if necessary, roll back to v2.3.0 after investigation. We will provide status updates on the incident page."

oncall-bot: Canary health check configured: check_latency.py --threshold 50 --error_rate 2 --window 2m. Alerting to #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime.

maria.s: For ops: command to pin rollout via deploybot (will run during window):
```
/deploybot pin runtime v2.3.1 --scope hosted --regions eu-west,us-central --stagger 30m --canary 3
```
Manual rollback command (requires eng-sre approval):
```
/deploybot rollback runtime v2.3.0 --scope hosted --regions <affected> --force
```

liaison.cust: Can we include a short SMS blurb for high-touch customers?

sophia.k: SMS blurb (<=160 chars):
```
Redwood planned maintenance Nov 1 02:00 UTC — brief runtime pinning may affect long-context latency. See status.redwood.ai for updates.
```

tyler.r: Approved from eng-rel. maria — please be ready to execute rollback steps and join #eng-oncall during window.

maria.s: I'll be on-call and will have runbooks open. If canary alert fires I'll pause and post summary in this thread.

sophia.k: OK. Final checklist before we publish to customers tomorrow at 20:00 UTC: 1) oncall + eng-rel signoff (this thread) 2) statuspage link created 3) email & SMS templates loaded into Zendesk 4) support rotation assigned.

tyler.r: signoff from eng-rel here. :white_check_mark:

maria.s: oncall signoff. :white_check_mark:

sophia.k: thanks all — I'll schedule the customer blast and update the statuspage at 20:00 UTC. Will post final published links in this thread.

deploy-bot: Status update scheduled: publish at 2024-10-31 20:00 UTC -> /status/incident/abcd-1234 will be live then.
